name: Question 15
problem:
Let $F(x)=x+4$ for $x\in [0,\pi ).$ Select the correct missing parts in the Fourier cosine series of the **even** $2\pi $-periodic extension $f(x)$ of the function $F(x)$ below.

$$
f(x)∼(4+\frac{\pi }{2})+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\,{{field-1}}\cdot {{field-2}}
$$
